items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was going to take piano lessons from Maude Thomas

ctx.x: How did you find your... Besides hearing it around the house, when did you find that moment where you actually became a participant in this?
I think I was about 4 years old, and my older brother was 8, and he was going to take piano lessons from Maude Thomas. She wasn’t married. Widow. What do you call that, when she’s not married?
